assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Focus Quest Flutter action RPG stage background, a single standalone opaque PNG, widescreen 16:9 landscape. Authentic 16-bit pixel art matching a cheerful grassland game background and small chibi 64x64 logical-grid sprites. Uniform visible square pixel clusters, crisp stepped edges, restrained palette, simple 2-3 tone shading, no blur or anti-aliasing. Side-on horizontal battle camera, not isometric or top-down. Broad unobstructed horizontal ground extends continuously across the image: clear battle strip in the lower quarter, feet contact line at 88.5% of image height, narrow ground cross-section at bottom. The player will occupy the left and the enemy the right; keep both areas empty and easily readable with subdued background contrast. Fill canvas edge-to-edge. No characters, ghosts with faces, creatures, enemies, people, UI, lettering, logos, watermark, borders, collage, or sprite sheet. No photographic, painted, 3D, or smooth gradient rendering. Primary request: haunted ghost ship stage. Scene: the broad weathered wooden deck of an ancient abandoned sailing ship at night, blue-green moonlit ocean beyond a low distant railing, torn sails and broken masts in the upper/background portion, ropes and a few ghostly turquoise lanterns at the far edges, thin mist rendered as solid pixel clusters, distant pale moon behind fragmented dark clouds. Ominous but beautiful fantasy atmosphere. Palette muted navy, teal, weathered brown with restrained pale turquoise lighting. Keep the near deck flat, wide and empty, no masts, barrels, ropes, rails or holes blocking the fighting ground. View across the deck sideways with distant ship features behind the playable strip; no deck corridor vanishing point.
